To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The yeast vacuole/ lysosome is essential for cell-cycle progression and that a combination of an acute block in vacuole biogeneration with a defect in organelle inheritance results in a specific cell-cycle arrest in early G1.

the vacuole plays an essential positive role in the cell cycle and that a defect in the vacuolar inheritance pathway results in an alternative pathway that generates a new vacuolar compartment prior to the next division.
the vacuole is required for the initiation of the cell cycle in yeast and that the TORC1-Sch9 pathway is required for this function.

the mechanisms that control the cell-cycle in yeast and mammalian cells, and the role of the lysosome/vacuole in these processes.
the role of the yeast vacuolar compartment in cell-cycle progression.
the regulation of the cell cycle.
